facets.name: overview
facets.label: Overview
facets.describes: What this area of the business owns, what it consumes from elsewhere, and what it deliberately does not own.

facets.name: glossary
facets.label: Glossary
facets.describes: The words this area uses and what each one means here. One row per word, with the aliases it is also known by, so two names for one thing can be found.

facets.name: business-rules
facets.label: Business Rules
facets.describes: What must hold in this area. One heading per rule, which is also what the Commands and Events tables link to when they cite the rule they came from.

facets.name: commands
facets.label: Commands
facets.describes: Requests that something happen. Each needs who may ask for it and what it is meant to achieve; without an actor, a command says nothing about who is allowed to do it.

facets.name: events
facets.label: Events
facets.describes: Business facts that have already happened, which other areas react to. Each needs what it means and the Rule it came from, so a reader can trace why it exists.

facets.name: workflows
facets.label: Workflows
facets.describes: How work actually moves through this area, end to end. One heading per workflow.

facets.name: state-machines
facets.label: State Machines
facets.describes: Which state something may move to from which, and what has to be true for it to move. One row per transition, with the guard that permits it.
